value.rationale: The ordinary coloring count or Euler characteristic alone cannot reveal whether both homological parities are present. Exact S5×S4 character projections reveal two different five-dimensional irreducibles forced in opposite parities in the natural Hom complex of the canonical odd Kneser graph. This is a substantive equivariant topological constraint and an explicit benchmark for graph-coloring complexes, without assuming a larger theorem.
